description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe in front of a pile of stacked firewood; three-quarter length view, face in profile (turned towards viewer left), hair pulled back from face into a bun,  hands clasped together at waist, collared long-sleeve buttoned jacket with pockets worn over blouse and skirt; all garments similarly colored, Alexander Calder brooch on viewer right lapel.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe, Abiquiu
